subject: Banking
title: Silicon Valley Bank: 48-Hour Collapse
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Silicon Valley Bank: 48-Hour Collapse.

hook.text: Silicon Valley Bank collapsed in 48 hours in March 2023.

buildup.text: SVB invested deposits in long-term government bonds. When the Fed raised rates, those bonds lost $15 billion in value.

discovery.text: 96% of SVB deposits were above the $250,000 FDIC insurance limit. Tech startups held millions per account.

twist.text: The FDIC stepped in and guaranteed ALL deposits, even uninsured ones.

climax.text: SVB was the first social media bank run. Twitter and group chats spread panic faster than any 1930s headline could.

punchline.text: $42 billion in one day. The first bank run driven by apps and tweets.

quiz.question: What percentage of SVB deposits were above the FDIC insurance limit?
